name: October 10-11 2025 Tariff-Shock Liquidation Cascade (largest liquidation event in crypto history; Binance USDe/wBETH/BNSOL collateral-oracle loop)

window_utc.notes: Start = first Trump tariff-threat post (~10:57 ET, minute approximate); acute cascade 20:50-22:16 UTC Oct 10; Binance's official depeg window 21:36-22:16 UTC; acute phase over by Oct 13 (BTC >$114k, compensation announced). Aftershocks ran into Nov 2025.

speed: BTC -14.5% peak-to-trough in ~6.5h, with the bulk (-10%) in ~20 minutes (21:00-21:21 UTC); alts -40-70% (wicks to -99%) within the hour; USDe -35% on Binance inside a 40-min window (21:36-22:16 UTC); $19.1-19.35B liquidated in 24h (~1.6M traders) — largest liquidation event in crypto history
summary: 10 октября 2025, 21:00-21:21 UTC: крупнейший каскад ликвидаций в истории — $19.1-19.35B за сутки (~1.6M трейдеров), BTC −14.5% за 6.5ч (−10% за 20 минут), альты −40-70%, USDe $0.65 НА BINANCE (петля unified-margin оракула; on-chain $0.985+), wBETH/BNSOL −88% на внутренних книгах. On-chain USDC-рельсы прошли БЕЗ ПОВРЕЖДЕНИЙ: Aave провёл рекордные ~$180M ликвидаций за час без bad debt (Chainlink-оракулы отказались брать биржевые принты). Внутридневная скорость заведомо быстрее дневного цикла SPA — это свойство системы, лаборатория его показывает. Отложенный хвост — Stream/xUSD (H14). Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: BTC prints all-time high above $126,000; total futures OI near records after months of low volatility — maximum-leverage backdrop. Binance had announced (Oct 6) an oracle/index update for collateral assets scheduled for Oct 14, leaving a known transition window.

Trump Truth Social post threatens a 'massive increase of tariffs' on China over its rare-earth export controls (~10:57 ET; minute approximate). BTC slides from ~$122.5k to below $119k alongside equities; S&P 500 ends -2.7%, worst day since April.

After US equity close, Trump announces 100% tariff on China 'over and above' existing tariffs, effective Nov 1, plus export controls on 'any and all critical software' (post time ~20:50-21:04 UTC, minute not independently verified; Reuters wire ~21:03 UTC). Crypto is the only major market open. A pre-positioned Hyperliquid short (~$160-200M profit) opened ~30 min earlier fuels later insider-trading allegations (unproven).

Cascade wave 1 (21:00-21:21 UTC): BTC falls ~$117k -> ~$105k in roughly 20 minutes; aggregate low $104,782.88 (Reuters), wicks ~$102k on some venues. ETH to ~$3,430-3,510 (-~20%). Alts -40-70% intraday: XRP -40/41%, DOGE -50%, AAVE -64% ($278.27->$100.18); ATOM briefly prints ~$0.001 on Binance; SOL -~40% wick. Prices bottom 21:20-21:21 UTC.

Binance's official 'depeg window' begins (21:36-22:16 UTC, per Binance's own announcement): Unified-Account collateral (USDe, wBETH, BNSOL) is valued off Binance's OWN thin spot orderbooks; liquidated collateral is sold into the same books that price it -> self-referential loop. USDe prints ~$0.65 on Binance spot (-35%; feeds show $0.62-0.66) while trading within ~0.3% of $1.00 on Bybit/Curve/Uniswap; wBETH wicks to ~$430 (~-90%) and BNSOL from ~$300 to ~$35 (~-88%). ADL fires across venues; USDT briefly trades at ~$1.006 premium; Rabby/DeBank wallet front-ends halt transactions; CoW Swap prints aberrant fills.

Ethena publicly confirms operations normal: mint/redeem never stopped, ~$2B of USDe redeemed within 24h without delay; Chainlink and DeFi oracles held USDe at ~$1.00 throughout, so NO on-chain liquidation cascade (exact post time low confidence).

24h tally: $19.1-19.35B liquidated (largest in crypto history; ~$16.7B longs), ~1.6-1.67M traders; largest single liquidation $203.36M (ETH position on Hyperliquid); CoinDesk 20 index -12.1%. CoinGlass and exchange executives note the true total is materially HIGHER because exchange APIs throttle liquidation reporting. BTC rebounds to ~$113k.

Venue damage assessed: Hyperliquid — ~$10.3B liquidations, $1.23B trader capital erased, >1,000 wallets fully wiped, 6,300 in the red, 205 lost >$1M each; HLP liquidator vault PROFITED >$40M in one day; OI $15B->$6B. Lighter avoided ADL but suffered multi-hour outage. DeFi held: Aave processed a record ~$180M of liquidations in ~1h with no bad debt ('largest stress test'); Morpho ~$100M, no bad debt.

Ethena publishes unscheduled proof-of-reserves: USDe overcollateralized by ~$66M on ~$9.65B supply, verified by independent attestors (Chaos Labs, Chainlink, Llama Risk, Harris & Trotter); short-perp hedges profited as prices fell. (Attestation is well documented; exact hour secondary-sourced.)

Binance announces compensation for all Futures/Margin/Loans users liquidated in the 21:36-22:16 UTC window (paid vs the 2025-10-11 00:00 UTC market price; ~$283M ultimately paid on this track) and accelerates the oracle fix: redemption prices added to the collateral index weights + a minimum price threshold (soft floor) for the USDe index, pulled forward from Oct 14 to Oct 11-12.

Acute phase ends: BTC back above $114-115k (+~12% off lows), spot BTC ETFs take ~$420M inflows; derivatives funding rates at lowest since the 2022 bear market; >$10B of BTC open interest erased. CoinDesk publishes 'No, Ethena's USDe Didn't De-peg'. Reuters totals the event at a record ~$19B day / ~$25B including the weekend.

Binance launches $400M 'Together' support initiative ($300M vouchers to force-liquidated retail users + $100M institutional liquidity facility), framed as confidence-restoring, explicitly not an admission of liability.

Structural aftermath: market-maker balance sheets impaired, altcoin orderbook depth stays sharply reduced for months, OI rebuild is slow, funding stays depressed; USDe supply contracts from ~$9.6B toward ~$6B over the following weeks as leveraged carry unwinds. Market never reclaims the Oct 6 ATH; BTC drifts to ~$110k mid-October and breaks below $100k in early November.

Aftershock 1: Balancer v2 Composable Stable Pools exploited across ~6 chains (old rounding/scaling bug); estimates rose $70M -> $110-117M -> ~$128M; Berachain halted and forked its network; StakeWise recovered $19.3M (5,041 osETH), Berachain Foundation $12.8M. Same day, Stream Finance suspends all deposits/withdrawals after an external fund manager discloses ~$93M loss of user assets (loss widely linked to Oct 10-11 trading).

Aftershock 2: Stream's xUSD collapses from $1 to ~$0.43 within hours (-77% first day; later prints ~$0.23-0.24); on-chain data shows ~$170M assets vs ~$530M loans (>4x leverage); analysts map ~$285M of loans across Euler, Silo, Morpho markets and curators (TelosC, MEV Capital, Re7) secured by xUSD/xBTC/xETH; Elixir's deUSD (large Stream creditor) is subsequently wound down. Curated-vault/synthetic-yield contagion — the deferred casualty of Oct 10.

stablecoins.notes: NOT a solvency depeg: venue-local oracle artifact of Binance's own-orderbook collateral index. Ethena stayed overcollateralized (~$66M on ~$9.65B supply, attested by Chaos Labs/Chainlink/Llama Risk/Harris & Trotter); mint/redeem uninterrupted, ~$2B redeemed in 24h; short-perp hedge PROFITED as prices fell. Binance paid ~$283M compensation and added redemption prices + a price floor to its USDe index. Supply later contracted ~$9.6B -> ~$6B as leveraged carry unwound.

LST (not a stablecoin) — included because its ETH-peg break drove the collateral loop: ~-89% vs par (ETH ~$3,700-3,900 at the time) on Binance's internal books; par elsewhere and redeemable at par at issuer. Covered by Binance compensation. Wick level medium confidence.
Binance Staked SOL LST: ~$300 -> ~$35 (~-88%) on Binance internal books; same mechanism and compensation. Wick level medium confidence.
Traded at a PREMIUM (~$1.006) as the flight-to-cash asset; no downside depeg. Tether/Circle minted billions in the following days to meet demand.
No notable depeg in this event; held ~$1.00 (this crisis, unlike SVB-Mar-2023, did not touch USDC's peg).

True insolvency collapse (aftershock of Oct 10 losses): $1 -> ~$0.43 within hours of the $93M loss disclosure (-77% day one), later ~$0.23-0.24; withdrawals frozen; ~$285M loans secured by xUSD/xBTC/xETH across Euler/Silo/Morpho; Elixir deUSD (large creditor) wound down. Contrast case to USDe: opaque, leveraged (>4x), no attested reserves.

tvl.notes: No reliably sourced global DeFi TVL delta obtained for Oct 10-13 (DeFiLlama daily series can supply it — see data_availability); Balancer TVL fell ~50% after its Nov 3 exploit; USDe/Ethena TVL contracted ~$9.6B -> ~$6B over the following weeks.

bad_debt_usd.notes: Aave processed a record ~$180M of liquidations in ~1h and Morpho ~$100M with NO bad debt reported — because Chainlink-style oracles held USDe/collateral at par, refusing the CEX prints. ~$4.8B of Aave positions were at risk had oracles tracked Binance prices. Deferred bad debt arrived via aftershocks: Stream Finance $93M direct loss + ~$285M xUSD/xBTC/xETH-collateralized loan web (Nov), Balancer exploit $116-128M (Nov 3).

liquidations_usd.notes: CoinGlass-derived totals $19.1-19.35B; systematically UNDERREPORTED (exchange APIs throttle liquidation feeds — Binance ~1 order/sec/symbol); Reuters later called it a record '~$25B' crash including the weekend; informal estimates run $30B+ (unverified).

defi_impact.gas_notes: No sourced gas figure obtained; infrastructure strain documented instead: Rabby and DeBank wallet front-ends halted transactions for tens of thousands of users, CoW Swap produced aberrant fills, Lighter had a multi-hour outage.
defi_impact.oracle_behavior: THE defining feature: Binance valued unified-margin collateral (USDe/wBETH/BNSOL) via an index built from its OWN spot orderbooks -> self-referential loop (collateral sold into the book that prices it). External/Chainlink oracles and every other major venue kept USDe ~$1.00, firewalling DeFi. Post-mortem fix (accelerated to Oct 11-12): redemption prices added into index weights + minimum price threshold on the USDe index + more frequent risk-parameter reviews.
defi_impact.withdrawal_freezes: None among major on-chain money markets during Oct 10-13 (Aave/Morpho/Maple/Pendle all operational; Ethena mint/redeem uninterrupted). CEX service degradation on Binance (compensated). Aftershock freezes: Stream Finance suspended all deposits/withdrawals Nov 3 (~$160M+ user funds trapped); Berachain halted its chain Nov 3 (Balancer exploit).
defi_impact.adl: Auto-deleveraging fired across major perp venues, force-closing profitable shorts to fill bankruptcy holes; Lighter was the notable major venue avoiding ADL (at the cost of an outage); Hyperliquid's HLP liquidator vault PROFITED >$40M that day.
defi_impact.perp_open_interest: BTC futures OI: >$10B erased within days (sourced); venue snapshots: Hyperliquid OI $15B -> $6B (-60%) in one day; one widely shared dashboard showed BTC perp OI $67B -> $33B (-51%), ETH $38B -> $19B, alts $43B -> $31B — magnitude contested between sources ('-43%' from the task brief could not be independently verified; treat aggregate OI drop as roughly -30% to -50%). Funding rates collapsed to lowest since the 2022 bear market.
defi_impact.protocols_insolvent_or_paused: October: none of the majors. November aftershocks: Stream Finance (insolvent, frozen), Elixir deUSD (wound down), Balancer v2 (exploited, TVL -50%), Berachain (temporary halt/fork).

causes.primary: Macro shock — Trump's surprise 100% China tariff announcement (~21:00 UTC Friday, after US equity close) hitting a record-leveraged crypto market as the only market open, into thin Friday-evening/weekend liquidity.
secondary: Record leverage/OI buildup after months of grind-up (BTC ATH Oct 6); crowded longs across 1.6M+ accounts
Binance Unified Account cross-margin accepting volatile/yield-bearing collateral (USDe, wBETH, BNSOL) VALUED ON BINANCE'S OWN SPOT ORDERBOOKS — a venue-internal, self-referential collateral oracle
Known oracle-fix transition window (announced Oct 6, scheduled Oct 14) — the crash hit inside it; Colin Wu and others argue this was exploited deliberately (unproven)
ADL mechanics closing profitable shorts to fill liquidation holes, amplifying dislocation; Lighter outage removed a venue
Market makers pulling quotes — unable to hedge as collateral marks collapsed; weekend/Friday-evening depth already thin
Pre-positioned large shorts minutes before the announcement (~$160-200M profit) — insider-trading allegations, never proven
Structural: liquidation reporting caps (Binance API ~1 order/sec/symbol) meant the real cascade was larger than the reported $19B
causes.mechanism: 100% tariff post (~20:50-21:04 UTC) -> instant risk-off in the only open market -> long liquidations begin -> thin books gap down -> BTC -10% in ~20 min, alts -40-70% -> Binance unified-margin accounts see USDe/wBETH/BNSOL collateral re-marked on Binance's own collapsing spot books -> equity evaporates -> forced liquidation of those accounts -> collateral dumped into the same thin books -> local prices collapse further (USDe $0.65, wBETH ~$430, BNSOL ~$35) -> next liquidation tier triggers; ADL storms close winners; insurance funds drain. Firewall: Chainlink/DeFi oracles kept USDe ~$1.00, so the loop stayed venue-local — Aave/Morpho processed record liquidations with no bad debt and DeFi avoided the spillover ($4.8B of Aave positions were at risk had oracles tracked CEX prints).

contagion: Trump 100% China tariff post ~20:50-21:04 UTC Oct 10 (after equity close)
crypto perp long liquidations begin across all venues (only open market)
BTC -10% in ~20 min (21:00-21:21 UTC), alts -40-70%, ATOM/alt wicks to near zero on thin books

Binance unified-margin collateral (USDe/wBETH/BNSOL) marked on Binance's OWN thin spot books -> collateral value collapse -> forced selling into the same books (self-referential oracle loop, 21:36-22:16 UTC)
USDe prints $0.65 ON BINANCE ONLY (on-chain/Bybit deviation <0.3%) -> 'Ethena depeg' panic headlines
ADL storms + insurance-fund drawdowns close profitable shorts across venues; Lighter outage
firewall holds: Chainlink oracles keep USDe ~$1 -> NO on-chain cascade; Aave liquidates $180M/1h with no bad debt; Ethena redeems ~$2B at par
$19.3B+ reported liquidations / ~1.6M traders; OI collapses (Hyperliquid -60%); funding to 2022 lows
market-maker balance sheets damaged -> altcoin depth impaired for months; USDe supply -$3B+; BTC never reclaims ATH, breaks <$100k early Nov

deferred casualties Nov 3-4: Stream Finance $93M loss + xUSD collapse ($1 -> $0.43 -> ~$0.23) -> ~$285M curated-vault loan contagion (Euler/Silo/Morpho/Elixir/TelosC) + Balancer v2 $116-128M exploit into the weakened market

recovery.time_to_recover: USDe on Binance: back near par within ~40-90 min (on-chain never left it); BTC: +12% off lows to >$114k within ~72h; market STRUCTURE (alt depth, OI, market-maker capacity): months — never fully restored before the Nov 2025 aftershocks
recovery.notes: V-shaped price bounce (BTC $104.8k -> $115k by Oct 12-13, ETF inflows ~$420M) but the event marked the cycle top: BTC never reclaimed the Oct 6 ATH ($126k), slid through late October and broke below $100k on Nov 4-5 2025 amid Balancer/Stream aftershocks; ETH ~$3,372 and SOL ~$158 by Nov 6. Altcoin orderbook depth and market-maker balance sheets stayed impaired for months (widely reported; hard depth series requires Kaiko-class paid data). USDe supply contracted ~$9.6B -> ~$6B; Ethena's design was VALIDATED (overcollateralized throughout) while the opaque copycats (Stream xUSD, Elixir deUSD) died three weeks later. Binance paid ~$283M compensation + $400M support program and fixed its collateral index.

confidence_notes: Research constraint: the sandbox egress proxy blocked all direct news/aggregator domains; primary/secondary sources were accessed via verbatim GitHub-hosted archives (TLDR newsletter mirror, Newsoid full-text news dumps with canonical URLs, yarb-web3 CoinDesk headline archive, independent research writeups quoting Binance's first-party posts) and cross-checked against the SPA repo's own previously verified research cards (data/stablecoin_cards/examples/usde.stablecoin.md, sourced 2026-07-02). All listed URLs were carried inside those archives; every headline number appears in >=2 independent mirrors. One GitHub dataset (an AI-summarization challenge repo containing deliberately planted errors) was identified and EXCLUDED as a source. OBSERVED (high confidence): BTC $122,574.46 -> $104,782.88 (-14.5%, Reuters); ATH >$126k Oct 6; $19.1-19.35B liquidations/24h with ~$16.7B longs; 1.6-1.67M traders; largest single liquidation $203.36M (Hyperliquid); Binance official depeg window 21:36-22:16 UTC and compensation terms; USDe ~$0.65 Binance-only print vs <0.3% on-chain deviation; Aave $180M/1h and Morpho ~$100M liquidations with no bad debt; AAVE -64%, XRP -41%, DOGE -50% wicks; CoinDesk 20 -12.1%; ~$283M compensation + $400M program; Stream Finance $93M/xUSD collapse and Balancer $116-128M exploit (Nov 3-4). APPROXIMATE/CONTESTED: exact Truth Social post times (morning threat ~14:57 UTC and 100%-tariff post ~20:50-21:04 UTC are inferred from wire timestamps and market microstructure, not a primary archive — minute-level marked observed=false); USDe exact low (feeds range $0.62-0.66; the often-quoted $0.6567 could not be independently confirmed here — 0.65 used); wBETH ~$430 and BNSOL ~$35 wicks (consistent across two independent writeups, medium confidence); Ethena PoR ~$66M over ~$9.65B supply and 12:29 GMT timing (attested event is well documented; figures via secondary mirrors, medium confidence); ~$2B USDe redemptions/24h (medium); total market-cap loss $400-600B (source-dependent; -$131B altcoins per Bloomberg-derived report); ETH low $3,430-3,510 band (venue-dependent). NOT VERIFIED (from the task brief, could not be sourced — treat as null): 'perp OI -43%' (sourced snapshots instead: Hyperliquid -60%, BTC OI >$10B erased, one contested dashboard -51%); 'CoinDesk average-token -47%' (no matching CoinDesk analysis found; the closest sourced aggregates are CoinDesk 20 -12.1% and Wiston Capital's altcoins-cratered analysis); ENA -80% intraday wick (only -40%+ daily is corroborated); claims of $30-40B 'true' liquidations (plausible direction given documented API throttling, but unverified — Reuters' later 'record $25B' is the highest number from a top-tier outlet). Ethereum gas levels during the event: no source obtained -> null.

Free: headline aggregates from news archives ($19.1-19.35B, 1.66M traders, $203.36M largest), on-chain Aave/Morpho liquidation events via Dune/subgraphs (free, complete).
data_availability.open_interest_funding: Funding-rate history: FREE and complete (Binance fapi fundingRate endpoint, full history — shows the collapse to 2022 lows). OI history: Binance API only keeps ~30 days -> Oct 2025 OI is NOT freely obtainable from exchanges now; CoinGlass/Laevitas/Glassnode OI history is paid. Hyperliquid's own info API has some historical stats free.
data_availability.gas: Etherscan API (free key): daily average gas price series; Dune (free): block-level base fee for the exact window. Adequate.
data_availability.not_obtainable_free: Exchange-internal ADL event logs and per-account liquidation ladders; Binance's internal collateral-index composition at event time (only described in announcements); minute-level cross-venue OI for Oct 2025; market-maker orderbook depth history (Kaiko/paid) needed to quantify the months-long liquidity impairment; CoinGlass historical minute liquidation data.
data_availability.replay_recommendation: For Protection Lab replay: drive the scenario off Binance 1m klines (USDE/USDT, WBETH/ETH, BNSOL/SOL, BTC, ETH), DeFiLlama daily TVL, Binance funding history, and Dune-derived Aave/Morpho liquidation + Curve USDe pool series; treat OI (-30..-50%) and liquidation tape as scenario parameters, not data.

spa_relevance.summary: For a $100k USDC yield book (Aave v3 USDC + Pendle PT + Maple + Morpho Steakhouse USDC + 10% cash) the Oct 10 cascade is the canonical 'NAV looks fine, everything else moved' event: on-chain USDC rails came through UNBROKEN (no bad debt, no freezes, USDC at $1), so realized loss ≈ 0 — but four of the book's five risk channels were live simultaneously and are largely unpriced if the system assumes USDC=1 and always-withdrawable protocols.

position_by_position.aave_v3_usdc: Not impaired — Aave processed a record $180M liquidations in ~1h with zero bad debt; USDC supplier principal intact, liquidation-driven borrow demand briefly SPIKES supply APY. The unpriced tail was counterfactual: ~$4.8B of positions were at risk had Aave's oracles tracked Binance's dislocated prints — oracle-divergence policy (Chainlink vs venue price) is the exact variable that separated 'no bad debt' from a socialized-loss event for USDC suppliers. Secondary channel: utilization spikes -> withdrawal latency risk at exactly the moment a derisk would want out.
position_by_position.pendle_pt: Hit through the MARK, not the principal: PT-sUSDe/PT-USDe discounts widened as implied yields spiked and AMM liquidity thinned (repo's own SYN_S05/SYN_S06 shape: PT to 0.80-0.85 with 3-5% exit haircut). Exiting during the window crystallizes a loss that held-to-maturity avoids — IF the underlying (USDe) stays solvent, which it did (overcollateralized ~$66M throughout, attested). The residual PT tail is exactly 'USDe-solvency-to-maturity' as underwritten in the repo's pt_susde_fixed candidate; Oct 10 is its live stress-pass. Post-event: funding collapse to 2022 lows crushes sUSDe carry -> future PT rolls price much lower APY (APY-collapse channel).
position_by_position.maple: No October default; the channel is CREDIT-WITH-LAG: Maple's borrower base (trading firms/market makers) is precisely the cohort whose balance sheets were damaged on Oct 10, and Stream Finance proved the disclosure lag runs ~3 weeks (loss taken ~Oct 10-11, disclosed Nov 3, instant freeze + 77% writedown). A paper model that marks Maple at par daily prices none of this; withdrawal queues/cooldowns mean the freeze arrives exactly when exit is wanted.
position_by_position.morpho_steakhouse_usdc: Morpho processed ~$100M liquidations with no bad debt on Oct 10 — the vault itself passed. But the November xUSD contagion (~$285M of loans across Euler/Silo/Morpho markets curated by TelosC/MEV Capital/Re7) demonstrated the curated-vault channel: vault quality = curator's collateral choices, and a curator reaching for synthetic-yield collateral converts 'blue-chip lending' into unsecured credit silently. Utilization-spike -> withdrawal-queue latency also applies.
position_by_position.cash_10pct_usdc: Worked as designed — USDC held $1.00 throughout (USDT even traded at a premium). Caveat: the event shows peg quality is VENUE-LOCAL (USDe was $1.00 on-chain and $0.65 on Binance simultaneously); a cash buffer marked off a single venue's feed can be mismarked in both directions.

unpriced_if_usdc_equals_1_and_always_wit: Venue-local price vs oracle price divergence (the entire USDe '$0.65' was this) — a NAV using one feed can panic-sell or miss real dislocation

Withdrawal-timing risk: utilization spikes / queue latency on Aave-Morpho, Maple cooldowns, and (aftershock) hard freezes (Stream) — 'withdrawable' failed exactly during the 40-minute window and for weeks in the Nov contagion

PT mark-to-market vs held-to-maturity accounting — exit haircut 3-5%+ during dislocation that reverts by maturity; a drawdown-triggered derisk that sells PTs into the wick REALIZES the artifact (repo's SYN_S05 trap)
APY collapse: funding to 2022 lows + leverage demand gone -> weeks-to-months of compressed carry across every sleeve; a plan priced off pre-crash APYs silently misses target
Credit-with-disclosure-lag on private-credit/curated sleeves (Maple borrowers, Morpho curators): losses incurred Oct 10 surfaced Nov 3

Infrastructure/timing: the acute phase ran 21:00-22:16 UTC FRIDAY with wallet front-ends (Rabby/DeBank) down and aberrant DEX fills — a daily 08:00-local cycle sees it 11-35h late; gas/execution assumptions of calm markets fail in the only window that matters
spa_relevance.kill_switch_note: A stable-only book's evidenced NAV drawdown through this event was likely well under the SOFT -5% tier — correct refusal-first behavior is HOLD (don't sell PTs into the artifact wick), which is what fail-CLOSED + Chainlink-anchored marks produce; the scenario's value for Protection Lab is testing that the ladder does NOT fire on venue-local artifacts while freeze/credit-lag channels are surfaced.

assumptions: USDC держал $1 (историч. факт) — депег-шока USDC нет.
